text_en: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord :
text_cn: 上主有话传给耶肋米亚说：

text_en: Stand in the gate of the Lord ’s house, and proclaim there this word, and say, Hear the word of the Lord , all you people of Judah, you that enter these gates to worship the Lord .
text_cn: 你站在上主殿宇的门口， 宣布这话说：你们凡由这些门进来，朝拜上主的犹大人，请听上主的话。

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: Amend your ways and your doings, and let me dwell with you in this place.
text_cn: 万军的上主，以色列的天主这样说：改善你们的生活和行为，我就让你们住在这地方；

text_en: Do not trust in these deceptive words: “This is the temple of the Lord , the temple of the Lord , the temple of the Lord . ”
text_cn: 不要信赖虚伪的话说：这是上主的圣殿，上主的圣殿，上主的圣殿！

text_en: For if you truly amend your ways and your doings, if you truly act justly one with another,
text_cn: 只有你们彻底改善你们的生活和行为，在人与人之间行事公道，

text_en: if you do not oppress the alien, the orphan, and the widow, or shed innocent blood in this place, and if you do not go after other gods to your own hurt,
text_cn: 不虐待旅客、孤儿、寡妇，不在这地方倾流无辜者的血，不自招祸患去跟随外方的神祇，

text_en: then I will dwell with you in this place, in the land that I gave of old to your ancestors forever and ever.
text_cn: 我才让你们住在这地方，即我从开始便永远赐给了你们祖先的土地。

text_en: Here you are, trusting in deceptive words to no avail.
text_cn: 可惜！你们竟信赖虚伪无益的话。

text_en: Will you steal, murder, commit adultery, swear falsely, make offerings to Baal, and go after other gods that you have not known,
text_cn: 怎么！你们竟偷盗，凶杀，通奸，发虚誓，向巴耳献香，跟随素不相识的外方神祇，

text_en: and then come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, “We are safe! ”—only to go on doing all these abominations?
text_cn: 然后来到这座归我名下的殿里，立在我面前说：“我们有了保障！”好再去行这一切可恶的事？

text_en: Has this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your sight? You know, I too am watching, says the Lord .
text_cn: 难道这座归我名下的殿宇，在你们眼中竟成了贼窝了吗？哎！我看实在是这样──上主的断语。

text_en: Go now to my place that was in Shiloh, where I made my name dwell at first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel.
text_cn: 那么，请你们到我昔日在史罗立我名的地方去，察看我因我人民以色列的邪恶对她行了的事。

text_en: And now, because you have done all these things, says the Lord , and when I spoke to you persistently, you did not listen, and when I called you, you did not answer,
text_cn: 现在因为你们做了这一切事──上主的断语──我再三恳切劝告你们，你们又不听；我呼唤你们，你们也不答应；

text_en: therefore I will do to the house that is called by my name, in which you trust, and to the place that I gave to you and to your ancestors, just what I did to Shiloh.
text_cn: 为此，我要对付你们依恃的这座归我名下的殿宇，并对付我给你们及你们祖先的地域，像对付史罗一样；

text_en: And I will cast you out of my sight, just as I cast out all your kinsfolk, all the offspring of Ephraim.
text_cn: 我必将你们由我面前抛弃，如同抛弃了你们所有的兄弟，厄弗辣因全体后裔一样。

text_en: As for you, do not pray for this people, do not raise a cry or prayer on their behalf, and do not intercede with me, for I will not hear you.
text_cn: 至于你，你不必为这人民祈祷，不必为他们呼吁哀求，也不必向我恳求，因为我不会俯听你。

text_en: Do you not see what they are doing in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
text_cn: 他们在犹大各城和耶路撒冷街道上做的是什么事，难道你没有看见？

text_en: The children gather wood, the fathers kindle fire, and the women knead dough, to make cakes for the queen of heaven; and they pour out drink offerings to other gods, to provoke me to anger.
text_cn: 儿子拾柴，父亲烧火，母女揉面给天后做饼，向外方神祇行奠祭，来触怒我。

text_en: Is it I whom they provoke? says the Lord . Is it not themselves, to their own hurt?
text_cn: 他们果真是触怒我吗？──上主的断语──岂不是触犯自己，使自己满面羞惭？

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God : My anger and my wrath shall be poured out on this place, on human beings and animals, on the trees of the field and the fruit of the ground; it will burn and not be quenched.
text_cn: 为此我主上主这样说：看，我的愤恨和怒火，必要倾注在这地方的人和走兽身上，田间的树木和土地的出产上，燃烧不熄。

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: Add your burnt offerings to your sacrifices, and eat the flesh.
text_cn: 万军的上主，以色列的天主这样说：“你们献祭后，尽管再加献全燔祭，尽管饱食祭肉；

text_en: For in the day that I brought your ancestors out of the land of Egypt, I did not speak to them or command them concerning burnt offerings and sacrifices.
text_cn: 可是，关于全燔祭和献祭的事情，我在领你们祖先出离埃及那一天，并没有对他们谈及或吩咐什么，

text_en: But this command I gave them, “Obey my voice, and I will be your God, and you shall be my people; and walk only in the way that I command you, so that it may be well with you. ”
text_cn: 只吩咐了他们这事说：你们应听从我的声音，那么我必作你们的天主，你们也必作我的人民；你们应走我吩咐你们的一切道路，好使你们获得幸福。

text_en: Yet they did not obey or incline their ear, but, in the stubbornness of their evil will, they walked in their own counsels, and looked backward rather than forward.
text_cn: 他们不但不侧耳细听，反倒依照自己的计谋，随自己邪恶的心生活，顽固不化；不以面向我，却以背向我。

text_en: From the day that your ancestors came out of the land of Egypt until this day, I have persistently sent all my servants the prophets to them, day after day;
text_cn: 从你们祖先出离埃及那一天起，直到今日，我给你们派遣了我所有的仆人先知，而且每天清早给你们派遣，

text_en: yet they did not listen to me, or pay attention, but they stiffened their necks. They did worse than their ancestors did.
text_cn: 但他们不但不侧耳听从我，反更硬起自己的颈项，比自己的祖先还要乖戾(lì)。

text_en: So you shall speak all these words to them, but they will not listen to you. You shall call to them, but they will not answer you.
text_cn: 纵使你将这一切话告诉他们，他们也不会听从你；任凭你怎样呼唤，他们也不会答应你。

text_en: You shall say to them: This is the nation that did not obey the voice of the Lord their God, and did not accept discipline; truth has perished; it is cut off from their lips.
text_cn: 为此你对他们说：这个民族，不听上主自己天主的声音，不肯接受教训；忠实已丧失，已绝于他们口中。

text_en: Cut off your hair and throw it away; raise a lamentation on the bare heights, for the Lord has rejected and forsaken the generation that provoked his wrath.
text_cn: 你该剪去你的一绺（liǔ）头发，把它抛掉，在高丘上唱哀歌，因为上主摈（bìn）斥，且抛弃了他憎恨的时代。

text_en: For the people of Judah have done evil in my sight, says the Lord ; they have set their abominations in the house that is called by my name, defiling it.
text_cn: 的确，犹大子民作了我视为邪恶的事──上主的断语──将他们可恶之物，安置在归我名下的殿宇里，使殿宇遭受玷污；

text_en: And they go on building the high place of Topheth, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire—which I did not command, nor did it come into my mind.
text_cn: 又在本希农山谷的托斐特建筑了丘坛，为火焚自己的子女；这是我从没有吩咐，也从没有想到的事。

text_en: Therefore, the days are surely coming, says the Lord , when it will no more be called Topheth, or the valley of the son of Hinnom, but the valley of Slaughter: for they will bury in Topheth until there is no more room.
text_cn: 为此，看，时日将到──上主的断语──人不再称这地方为“托斐特”，或“本希农谷”，却要称它为“屠杀谷”；由于坟地不够，连托斐特也将充作坟场。

text_en: The corpses of this people will be food for the birds of the air, and for the animals of the earth; and no one will frighten them away.
text_cn: 这人民的尸体将成为天空飞鸟和地上走兽的食物，而没有人来驱逐。

text_en: And I will bring to an end the sound of mirth and gladness, the voice of the bride and bridegroom in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem; for the land shall become a waste.
text_cn: 我必使犹大城内和耶路撒冷街上，再也听不到欢愉和喜乐的声音，新郎和新娘的声音，因为这地将要变为荒野。
